body:
The botanica is a space where ancestral wisdom and modern convenience coexist. It’s a place for everyday people to come find the healing magic they need — whether they’re looking to set intentions around love, protection, prosperity, or health.

This set employs the magic of three of the most potent and important herbs used in Latin American healing traditions: copal, palo santo, and sage. Together, they have the power to bring unparalleled healing, clearing harmful energy, easing stress, and uplifting the spirit.

Healing Candle

This 8” jar candle is anointed with a proprietary oil blend designed to promote total wellness and restore your spirit to its full vitality. Also known as veladoras in Hispanic culture, these candles were traditionally lit in prayer as a way of sending hopes and wishes to the heavens. We recommend placing this candle in a safe space and burning it continuously to illuminate your own intentions — of course, be sure to snuff it out nightly or when you leave the house if you need to!

Copal Incense Sticks

This set of 20 incense sticks is handcrafted with copal, a natural tree resin that has been burned as incense since ancient times to purify people, places, and things. Sacred to the ancient Mayans and Aztecs, copal is a potent healing tool that banishes low vibrations and brings clarity of vision. Burn these incense sticks in tandem with your Healing Candle to cleanse your spirit, strengthen your aura, and promote peace and positivity.

Copal, Palo Santo & Sage Soap

This healing soap is crafted from a natural blend of copal, palo santo, and sage — three of our absolute favorite ingredients for clearing stuck energy, raising vibrations, and opening pathways to prosperity and wellness. Add it to your healing bath rituals to restore both body and spirit, washing away all that no longer serves and welcoming a fresh infusion of uplifting energy.

  • Palo Santo: Palo santo is a sacred wood native to Central and South America that has been used for its medicinal and therapeutic powers for thousands of years. Burning palo santo is said to inspire creativity, clear negative energy, and provide energetic protection.
  • Sage: Sage is a sacred herb that has been used since ancient times to purify energy and raise vibrations. It's an essential tool for meditation and rituals, helping to relieve stress, open your mind, and invite positivity.
